records.public_claim_text: On average, 0.8% of total annual public expenditure is spent on the identification, conservation, protection and presentation of heritage.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: On average, 0.8% of total annual public expenditure is spent on the identification, conservation, protection and presentation of heritage.

records.public_claim_text: It should be noted that a significant number of States Parties did not respond to this question: 37% (19) States Parties for cultural heritage and 43% (22) in relation for natural heritage.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: It should be noted that a significant number of States Parties did not respond to this question: 37% (19) States Parties for cultural heritage and 43% (22) in relation for natural heritage.

records.public_claim_text: According to responses, 57% (29 out of 51) of the States Parties use it to raise awareness about the need to conserve and manage cultural and natural heritage followed by 53% (27) for the implementation of capacity-building at the national level.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: According to responses, 57% (29 out of 51) of the States Parties use it to raise awareness about the need to conserve and manage cultural and natural heritage followed by 53% (27) for the implementation of capacity-building at the national level.

records.public_claim_text: Only 28% of the States Parties in Europe and North America have a national strategy for capacity development in the field of heritage conservation, protection, presentation and management that is effectively implemented.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Only 28% of the States Parties in Europe and North America have a national strategy for capacity development in the field of heritage conservation, protection, presentation and management that is effectively implemented.

records.public_claim_text: 59% of the State Parties reported to have adequate capacity whereas 18% considered to have some capacity but significant deficiencies remain.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: 59% of the State Parties reported to have adequate capacity whereas 18% considered to have some capacity but significant deficiencies remain.

records.public_claim_text: A significant proportion (61% or 31 out of 51) of the States Parties reported that they do not have a national capacity-building strategy for the conservation, protection, presentation and management of World Heritage, but that capacity is built on an ad hoc basis.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: A significant proportion (61% or 31 out of 51) of the States Parties reported that they do not have a national capacity-building strategy for the conservation, protection, presentation and management of World Heritage, but that capacity is built on an ad hoc basis.

records.public_claim_text: It is important to recall here that only 28% of the States Parties have a national strategy for capacity development in the field of heritage conservation, protection, presentation and management that is effectively implemented, and that 51% have no such strategies.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: It is important to recall here that only 28% of the States Parties have a national strategy for capacity development in the field of heritage conservation, protection, presentation and management that is effectively implemented, and that 51% have no such strategies.

records.public_claim_text: Regarding education programmes for children and/or youth that contribute to improving understanding of heritage and promoting diversity and fostering intercultural dialogue, only 37% (19) of the States Parties responded that there are programmes that are effectively implemented.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Regarding education programmes for children and/or youth that contribute to improving understanding of heritage and promoting diversity and fostering intercultural dialogue, only 37% (19) of the States Parties responded that there are programmes that are effectively implemented.

records.public_claim_text: In almost half of the States Parties (47%) there are heritage education programmes but there are deficiencies in their implementation.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: In almost half of the States Parties (47%) there are heritage education programmes but there are deficiencies in their implementation.
